예레미야애가 3:1.content: I am the man that hath seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.

예레미야애가 3:2.content: He hath led me, and brought me into darkness, but not into light.

예레미야애가 3:3.content: Surely against me is he turned; he turneth his hand against me all the day.

예레미야애가 3:4.content: My flesh and my skin hath he made old; he hath broken my bones.

예레미야애가 3:5.content: He hath builded against me, and compassed me with gall and travail.

예레미야애가 3:6.content: He hath set me in dark places, as they that be dead of old.

예레미야애가 3:7.content: He hath hedged me about, that I cannot get out: he hath made my chain heavy.

예레미야애가 3:8.content: Also when I cry and shout, he shutteth out my prayer.

예레미야애가 3:9.content: He hath inclosed my ways with hewn stone, he hath made my paths crooked.

예레미야애가 3:10.content: He was unto me as a bear lying in wait, and as a lion in secret places.

예레미야애가 3:11.content: He hath turned aside my ways, and pulled me in pieces: he hath made me desolate.

예레미야애가 3:12.content: He hath bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.

예레미야애가 3:13.content: He hath caused the arrows of his quiver to enter into my reins.

예레미야애가 3:14.content: I was a derision to all my people; and their song all the day.

예레미야애가 3:15.content: He hath filled me with bitterness, he hath made me drunken with wormwood.

예레미야애가 3:16.content: He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones, he hath covered me with ashes.

예레미야애가 3:17.content: And thou hast removed my soul far off from peace: I forgat prosperity.

예레미야애가 3:18.content: And I said, My strength and my hope is perished from the Lord:

예레미야애가 3:19.content: Remembering mine affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the gall.

예레미야애가 3:20.content: My soul hath them still in remembrance, and is humbled in me.

예레미야애가 3:21.content: This I recall to my mind, therefore have I hope.

예레미야애가 3:22.content: It is of the Lord’s mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.

예레미야애가 3:23.content: They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.

예레미야애가 3:24.content: The Lord is my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.

예레미야애가 3:25.content: The Lord is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul that seeketh him.

예레미야애가 3:26.content: It is good that a man should both hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the Lord.

예레미야애가 3:27.content: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.

예레미야애가 3:28.content: He sitteth alone and keepeth silence, because he hath borne it upon him.

예레미야애가 3:29.content: He putteth his mouth in the dust; if so be there may be hope.

예레미야애가 3:30.content: He giveth his cheek to him that smiteth him: he is filled full with reproach.

예레미야애가 3:31.content: For the Lord will not cast off for ever:

예레미야애가 3:32.content: But though he cause grief, yet will he have compassion according to the multitude of his mercies.

예레미야애가 3:33.content: For he doth not afflict willingly nor grieve the children of men.

예레미야애가 3:34.content: To crush under his feet all the prisoners of the earth,

예레미야애가 3:35.content: To turn aside the right of a man before the face of the most High,

예레미야애가 3:36.content: To subvert a man in his cause, the Lord approveth not.

예레미야애가 3:37.content: Who is he that saith, and it cometh to pass, when the Lord commandeth it not?

예레미야애가 3:38.content: Out of the mouth of the most High proceedeth not evil and good?

예레미야애가 3:39.content: Wherefore doth a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?

예레미야애가 3:40.content: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the Lord.

예레미야애가 3:41.content: Let us lift up our heart with our hands unto God in the heavens.

예레미야애가 3:42.content: We have transgressed and have rebelled: thou hast not pardoned.

예레미야애가 3:43.content: Thou hast covered with anger, and persecuted us: thou hast slain, thou hast not pitied.

예레미야애가 3:44.content: Thou hast covered thyself with a cloud, that our prayer should not pass through.

예레미야애가 3:45.content: Thou hast made us as the offscouring and refuse in the midst of the people.

예레미야애가 3:46.content: All our enemies have opened their mouths against us.

예레미야애가 3:47.content: Fear and a snare is come upon us, desolation and destruction.

예레미야애가 3:48.content: Mine eye runneth down with rivers of water for the destruction of the daughter of my people.

예레미야애가 3:49.content: Mine eye trickleth down, and ceaseth not, without any intermission,

예레미야애가 3:50.content: Till the Lord look down, and behold from heaven.

예레미야애가 3:51.content: Mine eye affecteth mine heart because of all the daughters of my city.

예레미야애가 3:52.content: Mine enemies chased me sore, like a bird, without cause.

예레미야애가 3:53.content: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and cast a stone upon me.

예레미야애가 3:54.content: Waters flowed over mine head; then I said, I am cut off.

예레미야애가 3:55.content: I called upon thy name, O Lord, out of the low dungeon.

예레미야애가 3:56.content: Thou hast heard my voice: hide not thine ear at my breathing, at my cry.

예레미야애가 3:57.content: Thou drewest near in the day that I called upon thee: thou saidst, Fear not.

예레미야애가 3:58.content: O Lord, thou hast pleaded the causes of my soul; thou hast redeemed my life.

예레미야애가 3:59.content: O Lord, thou hast seen my wrong: judge thou my cause.

예레미야애가 3:60.content: Thou hast seen all their vengeance and all their imaginations against me.

예레미야애가 3:61.content: Thou hast heard their reproach, O Lord, and all their imaginations against me;

예레미야애가 3:62.content: The lips of those that rose up against me, and their device against me all the day.

예레미야애가 3:63.content: Behold their sitting down, and their rising up; I am their musick.

예레미야애가 3:64.content: Render unto them a recompence, O Lord, according to the work of their hands.

예레미야애가 3:65.content: Give them sorrow of heart, thy curse unto them.

예레미야애가 3:66.content: Persecute and destroy them in anger from under the heavens of the Lord.
